ontology_garden.latent_state: feature defined categories with hidden exception regimes
ontology_garden.observation_schema: opaque local structured record without target or target digest
ontology_garden.target: private latent consequence revealed after committed response
ontology_garden.outcome_timing: after proposal and reasoning receipt are committed
ontology_garden.oracle: private latent structure and optimal admissible action
ontology_garden.maximum_compute_baseline: all candidate procedures with greater compute charge
ontology_garden.answer_leakage_test: target and target digest absent from observation serialization
ontology_garden.floor: random accuracy above zero and below oracle
ontology_garden.ceiling: oracle exactly reconstructs private latent consequence
